title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Culture around Systemic Change Survey: A tool for Assessing Departmental Culture in Physics
reasoning: The paper focuses on the psychometric validation of a survey instrument (CSCS) used to assess departmental culture in physics, specifically regarding equity and systemic change. While these topics involve social justice, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems; it is a tool-validation study in physics education research.
